title: apiban.org – A Service To Share IP Addresses Of Bad SIP Traffic
html:
Fred Posner has recently launched a new project with LOD called APIBAN:

  • https://apiban.org

The site provides an API to share IP addresses of bad SIP traffic; allowing you to block the traffic before it reaches your RTC platform.

Examples are provided for integration with Kamailio (via http_client, jansson and htable modules) as well as an open source iptables client in Go.

The service is free, provided as a public Beta and an API key can be requested from the site itself.

Thanks for flying Kamailio!

Should you be aware of similar services or articles that you think worth sharing with the Kamailio community, let us know and we will gladly publish news about them.

Looking forward to meeting many of you at the 8th edition of Kamailio World Conference, April 27-29, 2020, in Berlin, Germany!
